# Pet Airlines

> Pet Airlines arranges door-to-door international pet transportation — full-service
> relocation, flight-only booking, and ground transport for pets moving between
> countries. Founded in 2014, the team handles documentation, customs clearance,
> IATA-compliant crates, and real-time updates so families aren't separated from
> their pets during a move. Core routes run between Canada, Korea, Vietnam, and
> France, with custom routing available worldwide.

Pet Airlines offers three tiers of service: Transport Services (door-to-door
international transport, flight-only transport, ground transport only),
Support Services (documentation handling, customs clearance, IATA-approved
travel crates), and Consulting (paid advisory sessions for pet owners handling
their own relocation). Quotes are requested through an online inquiry form and
typically returned within 24 hours.
